Barack Obama is elected as the first African American President of the United States.
The world's tallest skyscraper, the Burj Khalifa, is completed in Dubai.
The Arab Spring, a series of pro-democracy uprisings, begins across the Middle East and North Africa.
The largest oil spill in U.S. history occurs in the Gulf of Mexico after the Deepwater Horizon explosion.
The first iPad is released by Apple, popularizing the tablet computer.
U.S. forces kill Osama bin Laden, the leader of al-Qaeda, in Pakistan.
The Higgs boson particle is discovered at CERN's Large Hadron Collider.
Pope Francis is elected, becoming the first pope from the Americas.
Russia annexes Crimea from Ukraine, leading to international condemnation.
The Paris Agreement on climate change is adopted by nearly every country in the world.
The CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing method is first used on human embryos.
The United Kingdom votes to leave the European Union in the "Brexit" referendum.
The augmented reality game Pokémon Go is released, becoming a global phenomenon.
The first detection of a gravitational wave from a neutron star merger is announced.
The first image of a black hole is captured by the Event Horizon Telescope.
The World Health Organization declares the COVID-19 outbreak a global pandemic.
The first mRNA vaccines for COVID-19 are developed and approved for public use.
The James Webb Space Telescope is launched, succeeding the Hubble Space Telescope.
Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
The generative AI model ChatGPT is launched to the public, sparking widespread interest in artificial intelligence.
